source_note: Qi 2023: ambient and boundary pressures; 4.2 mg/s measured after cooldown; low drop 45 kPa is the authors' model estimate at that condition. 42 mm x 9.5 mm and 9.5 mm square give two-face areas. Emissivity 0.15 is the authors' fitted effective insulation value. High-side drop 50 kPa, axial conductance 5 microW/K, platform resistance 100 K/W, effectiveness 0.995 and linear-wall radiation profile are project assumptions. Effectiveness is defined here as fraction of pinch-limited maximum transfer, not Qi's Eq. A2. Flow is prescribed, NOT solved from restriction.
